# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 21 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 21
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. It is good that a man who has learned judgments of the Lord, as many as are written, should walk in them. For he who does these things will be glorified in the kingdom of God; but he who chooses those other things will perish with his works.
2. It is for this reason there is a resurrection, it is for this reason there will be a recompense. I implore those who are in high position, if you receive any of my good counsel, keep among you those persons by whom you are being helped; do not fail in this.
3. The day is near in which all things will perish with the evil one. The Lord and his reward are near.
4. I urge you again and again: be good lawmakers to one another; remain faithful counselors to one another; remove from among you all hypocrisy.
5. And may God, the Lord of all the world, give you wisdom, understanding, insight, knowledge of his righteous ordinances, and patience.
6. Be instructed by God, searching out what the Lord requires of you, and do it, so that on the day of judgment you may be found worthy.
7. But if there is any memory of the good, remember me as well, meditating on these things, so that both my desire and my watching over you may lead to some good.
8. I beg you: ask it as a favor of one another; be faithful.
